benefits.name: Rewards
benefits.details: At Nestlé, we prioritise your growth, recognition, and well-being. You will be recognized for your contribution with a competitive salary, benefits package as well as an environment that fosters work-life balance, health and wellness. And you may benefit from savings plans, insurance, loans, and discounted Nestlé products.

benefits.name: Growing Careers
benefits.details: You own your career journey at Nestlé. We are here to support you in cultivating a progressive career by offering diverse professional experiences that align with your capabilities and aspirations. Whether it’s leading teams, collaborating with experts, or exploring cross-functional opportunities, we provide you with experiential, relationship-building, and educational tools to thrive on your chosen growth path.

benefits.name: Performance Driven Culture
benefits.details: You can experience a growth-oriented ecosystem where performance is valued, equal opportunities are provided, and assessments are based on fair results and approaches. We not only reward achievements but also recognize the importance of how they were achieved. At Nestlé, we believe and encourage the premise that exceptional behaviours fuel outstanding performance, resulting in a future-oriented company.

benefits.name: Health, Wellbeing & Support
benefits.details: Our working environments vary greatly, so depending on your job and your location, you could benefit from flexible working opportunities, volunteering programs, the ability to bring a pet to work, and much more.

benefits.name: Inclusive Policies
benefits.details: At the heart of our values is inclusion, reflected in our comprehensive policies and practices. We prioritize equality by extending benefits to embrace all forms of diversity. This includes insurance coverage for same-sex partners and ensuring equal opportunities for employees with disabilities through disability cover and accommodations. These inclusive policies exemplify our dedication to cultivating a diverse and supportive environment for everyone.

benefits.name: Parental Benefits
benefits.details: We take pride in supporting our employees in their parenthood journey. Our inclusive workplace offers 26 weeks of parental leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers. This policy extends to adopting and surrogate parents, providing them with 26 weeks of parental leave to bond with their new family. Our facilities are equipped with lactation rooms, and we offer benefits such as on-site creches and financial assistance for childcare services. To celebrate the arrival of a new addition, we provide a hamper for new parents
